description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa models of different sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning methods, labeled as Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "GLUE Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 85 to 89, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Each fine-tuning method is represented by a pair of bars, colored blue for the "base" RoBERTa size and orange for the "large" RoBERTa size, as indicated by the legend. The bars for the "large" models are consistently taller than their "base" counterparts, except for the S1-model, where the "base" bar is slightly taller. The tallest bar is for the S5-model with the "large" RoBERTa size, reaching approximately 88.5, while the shortest bar is for Adaptor with the "base" RoBERTa size, at around 85. The bars are grouped by fine-tuning method, with the "base" and "large" bars appearing side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the fine-tuning methods, and no bars are visually emphasized.
